findings.issue: Invalid CAP record could still publish nominal_timing
findings.resolution: Structural cap-kind check separated; timing assigned only without errors; all negative checker cases assert None timing
findings.verification: Source delta read plus saved decoder02 PASS; decoder01 and freeze-r1 retained; no ARM/native repeat

limitations: Positive DATA bytes are known FIFO acceptance, not USB delivery or committed raw prefix.
Prepare time is inclusive of IRQ/observer and cached or EMPTY calls; incomplete prepare excluded and flagged.
One attempt per boot. First close precedes cleanup; cap is an observation checkpoint and may hide a later fault.
Pre-ACTIVE NULL ADC fail cannot bind EMPTY; refused START and original legacy ADC reason remain distinct.
Pair validity needs exact build/readback/nonce/generation and operator evidence; decoder does not independently authenticate physical identity.
DWT modulo timing needs no halt/reset and less than one wrap at assumed nominal72MHz; no CPU-share/WCET or observer-overhead correction.
Native C fixture is API stress, not a complete production-reachable session; full runtime and physical timing not executed.
28 static bytes remain above the retained8192 stack reserve; any growth requires a new resource review.

C1.basis: First-close, identity, typed causes and honest unavailable/acceptance semantics

C2.basis: Freeze, late-write suppression, saturation and exact bounds; tight static margin and observer timing explicitly limited

C3.basis: Exact ARM, actual-C hooks/fixture, negative decoder and source equality; logical seams disclosed

C4.basis: One64B bank, no ISR/private-static writers, bounded hooks and documented ABI

C5.basis: Exact commands/pins/archive, preserved earlier decoder evidence and reproducible baseline
